description:
A single Instagram post/reel by URL or shortcode: owner, type, likes, comments, views, caption, timestamp, thumbnail and video URL.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `shortcode`.
Returns: shortcode (string), media_id (string, nullable), link (string), owner_username (string, nullable), type (string), is_video (boolean), product_type (string, nullable), like_count (integer, nullable), like_and_view_counts_disabled (boolean, nullable), comment_count (integer, nullable), view_count (integer, nullable), taken_at (integer, nullable), taken_at_text (string, nullable), caption (string), thumbnail_url (string, nullable), video_url (string, nullable).

shortcode.description: Post shortcode; alias used only when url is empty. Example: "DYxz0A8Kinw"

url.description: Post, reel or IGTV URL (a bare shortcode also works). Example: "https://www.instagram.com/p/DYxz0A8Kinw/"

name: instagram_post
title: Instagram post
